form: A complete answer must specify the set \(\mathcal G\) exactly, by an explicit description or an equivalent necessary-and-sufficient condition on every real \(\eta>0\), including whether the set is empty.
not_enough: Bounds or partial inclusions for \(\mathcal G\), isolated examples or exclusions, results covering only some positive \(\eta\), or a description conditional on an unproved conjecture would not settle the question.
